patch_description: Restructured as a staged pipeline: (1) an initializer module producing diverse seeds (random, cube/antipodal, icosahedral projections), (2) a projected-gradient relaxation loop on the unit sphere that pushes *all* near-minimal pairs apart (not just the single closest pair), with annealed step sizes and occasional stochastic kicks, (3) a scoring/selection module. Since all points lie on the unit sphere, dmax is exactly 2, so maximizing dmin on the sphere directly maximizes the target ratio. This fixes the previous weak single-pair force heuristic and improves the achievable squared ratio substantially.
